checkpoints.description: [1/2] Add a short TTL around positive receipt stat validation

impact_assessment.benefits: Skip repeat stat calls within a one-second window while keeping writer invalidation and stamp validation on expiry
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first stat-counter test, invalidation tests, 200-receipt A/B, full npm suite and strict gates
impact_assessment.risks: contract: edited receipts are still detected after TTL or invalidation; dependency: Date.now via injectable clock; concurrency: process-local cache; state: TTL stored per cached receipt
impact_assessment.why: Present receipts are cached but every API poll still stats each sidecar to validate them; 200 receipts cost about 5ms per poll on this host

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Reuse one pairedDiffs result across all guard views of a candidate

impact_assessment.benefits: Compute the diffs once per candidate comparison while preserving b/c/p values exactly
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first counter test, group-guard tests, full tune suite and strict gates; revert on any guard difference
impact_assessment.risks: contract: guard b/c/p, group rates and winner unchanged; dependency: tune-measure pairedDiffs; concurrency: process-local counter; state: cache scoped to one balancedChoice call

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Cache evaluator load signatures per settings object and width

impact_assessment.benefits: Compute the load object and model/context signatures once per candidate/width while preserving all load/reconfigure decisions
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first counter test, evaluator/tune tests, 1000-measure A/B and strict gates; revert on any load/reconfigure difference
impact_assessment.risks: contract: model/context signatures and returned load object unchanged; dependency: WeakMap; concurrency: process-local per evaluator; state: settings object assumed stable per candidate as the tuner constructs it
impact_assessment.why: ensureLoaded recomputes three pick maps and two JSON.stringify signatures on every measure call although a candidate's settings object is reused across seeds, looks and chunks
